I saved this as a project convention in EngramDB, so future sessions and collaborators will see it:

> All timestamps in the database are stored in UTC. They are converted to the customer's timezone only in the API layer. Timestamps coming in through the API should be converted to UTC before they're saved.

That last sentence is my own addition, since it seems to follow from your rule. Tell me if it's wrong and I'll remove it. No existing memory covered or conflicted with this.
